HUD.ControlledToggle: {mount} is a controlled mount (click to make it independent)
HUD.IndependentToggle: {mount} is an independent mount (click to make it controlled)
HUD.FallSave: {rider}: DC 10 Dexterity save to stay mounted (the mount is being moved against its will)

Dialog.ControlledHint: the mount is trained to accept a rider. Its initiative changes to match the rider's, it moves as the rider directs, and on its turn it can only Dash, Disengage, or Dodge.
Dialog.IndependentHint: the mount lets the rider on but ignores their control. It keeps its place in the initiative order and moves and acts as it likes.
Dialog.PartnerPrompt: {token} overlaps more than one creature. Choose the pairing:

Effect.MountedDescription: Riding a mount. The rider moves with the mount and must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall off (landing Prone) if the mount is moved against its will, or if the rider or the mount is knocked Prone.
Effect.ControlledDescription: A controlled mount moves on its rider's turn as the rider directs, and has only three action options during that turn: Dash, Disengage, and Dodge.
Effect.IndependentDescription: An independent mount keeps its place in the initiative order and moves and acts as it likes.

Chat.MountCost: Mounting costs {cost} {units} of movement (half of a {speed} {units} Speed).
Chat.DismountCost: Dismounting costs {cost} {units} of movement (half of their Speed).
Chat.ControlledRules: {mount} is a controlled mount: its initiative now matches its rider's, it moves as directed, and on that turn it can only Dash, Disengage, or Dodge.
Chat.IndependentRules: {mount} is an independent mount: it keeps its place in the initiative order and moves and acts as it likes.
Chat.FeatModern: Mounted Combatant applies: {rider} has Advantage on attacks against unmounted creatures within 5 feet of the mount that are at least one size smaller than it (Mounted Strike); the mount takes no damage on a successful Dexterity save for half damage, and half on a failure (Leap Aside); and {rider} can take a hit meant for the mount (Veer).
Chat.FeatLegacy: Mounted Combatant applies: {rider} has advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than the mount; the mount takes no damage on a successful Dexterity save for half damage, and half on a failure; and {rider} can force an attack on the mount to target them instead.
Chat.OpportunityLegacy: If the mount provokes an opportunity attack while ridden, the attacker can target the rider or the mount.
Chat.MountFell: {mount} goes down and {rider} is thrown, landing Prone.
Chat.NowControlled: {rider} takes control of {mount}: it now acts on {rider}'s turn and can only Dash, Disengage, or Dodge.

Cause.mountProne: {mount} is knocked Prone with {rider} on its back.
Cause.forced: An effect is moving {mount} against its will while {rider} rides it.

Chat.FallReminder: {rider} must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall off, landing Prone within 5 feet of {mount}.
Chat.SavePrompt: {rider} must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall off, landing Prone within 5 feet of {mount}.
Chat.ReactionOption: {rider} is dismounted and lands Prone within 5 feet of {mount}. If they used their reaction to dismount as it fell, they land on their feet instead.
Chat.LandsOnFeet: {rider} uses their reaction and lands on their feet.
Chat.VeerModern: {rider} can force the attack to hit them instead (Veer).
Chat.RedirectLegacy: {rider} can force the attack to target them instead (AC {ac}).
Chat.VeerTiming: Choose before the damage is applied: the next damage applied to the mount is redirected.
Chat.VeerArmed: {rider} veers to take the hit meant for {mount}.
Chat.RedirectArmedMiss: {rider} draws the attack away from {mount}, and it misses.
Chat.VeerApplied: The damage meant for {mount} is applied to {rider}.
Chat.RedirectMissed: The redirected attack misses {rider}: {mount} takes no damage.

Notify.NoGM: Primal Mounts: a GM must be connected to do that, because you don't own both tokens.
Notify.InvalidPair: Those tokens can't form a mount pair.
Notify.AlreadyMounted: One of those creatures is already mounted or carrying a rider.
Notify.TooSmall: {mount} ({mountSize}) must be at least one size larger than {rider} ({riderSize}) to serve as a mount.
Notify.NoPermission: You don't have permission to do that.
Notify.NeedBoth: You must own both creatures to mount one on the other.
Notify.NothingToMount: Drag this token onto a larger creature (or a smaller creature onto it) first.
Notify.IndependentMount: {mount} is an independent mount and moves on its own. Move the mount, make it controlled, or Unmount first.
Notify.ControlledAction: {mount} is controlled by {rider}: on its turn it can only Dash, Disengage, or Dodge.
Notify.PairGone: That rider and mount are no longer together.

rulesVersion.Name: Mounted combat rules
rulesVersion.Hint: Which version of the mounted combat rules and the Mounted Combatant feat to apply. Automatic uses the feat's source book, then the D&D 5e system's rules setting.

enforceSize.Name: Mount must be at least one size larger
enforceSize.Hint: Only allow mounting a creature that is at least one size category larger than the rider. Turn off to let same-size creatures ride each other.

playersMountUnowned.Name: Players can mount creatures they don't own
playersMountUnowned.Hint: Let a player mount (or put a rider on) a creature as long as they own one of the two tokens. The GM's client carries out the change.

askControl.Name: Ask whether the mount is controlled
askControl.Hint: When mounting, ask whether the mount is controlled or independent. If off, low-Intelligence creatures are controlled and everything else is independent.

controlledMountActions.Name: Controlled mount action limit
controlledMountActions.Hint: During combat, a controlled mount can only Dash, Disengage, or Dodge. Choose what happens when it uses another action.

fallSaves.Name: Falling off
fallSaves.Hint: When the rider or the mount is knocked Prone, or the mount goes down: roll the rider's DC 10 Dexterity save automatically, post a button for the rider's owner to roll it, or only post a reminder.
fallSaves.Prompt: Ask the rider's owner to roll

removeProneOnSave.Name: Remove Prone when the rider keeps their seat
removeProneOnSave.Hint: If a rider knocked Prone succeeds on the save to stay mounted, remove the Prone condition.

mountedCombatant.Name: Automate Mounted Combatant
mountedCombatant.Hint: Apply Mounted Strike advantage, Leap Aside and Veer for riders who have the Mounted Combatant feat.

stackOrder.Name: Smaller tokens on top
stackOrder.Hint: When tokens overlap, keep smaller tokens drawn (and clickable) above larger ones, and riders above their mounts. The GM's client updates the stacking order.

chatCards.Name: Post mounting chat cards
chatCards.Hint: Post a chat message when creatures mount, dismount, fall off or change control. Cards with buttons are always posted.

autoShowHud.Name: Open the Token HUD after dropping onto a creature
autoShowHud.Hint: When you drag a token onto a creature it could mount (or be mounted by), open its Token HUD so the Mount button is ready.

fanOut.Name: Fan out stacked same-size tokens
fanOut.Hint: When same-size tokens sit on top of each other (at any elevation), draw them smaller and spread out so each one can be seen and clicked.

mountBadge.Name: Saddle badge on mounts
mountBadge.Hint: Mark a creature that is carrying a rider with a small saddle badge just outside its top-right corner (gold: controlled, grey: independent). It never covers the tokens.

raisedOpacity.Name: Opacity of a raised token over a smaller one
raisedOpacity.Hint: A token at a higher elevation stays drawn on top of the smaller tokens below it, but at this opacity so they show through, and clicks over a lower token select it. Hover the raised token to see it solid. 1 turns this off.

debug.Name: Debug logging
debug.Hint: Write mount movement details to the browser console (F12), to help troubleshoot.

riderScale.Name: Rider size on a mount
riderScale.Hint: How large a rider is drawn relative to its mount, so the mount stays visible (and clickable) around it. Riders are never drawn larger than their own token.
